limitations: The three streams are non-overlapping segments of one recording group, not independent recordings.
Event timestamps are synthesized at 30 fps because the images carry no timestamps; ordering and gaps come from the unchanged Phase 3B pipeline.
Only lifecycle events carrying feature values drive current; the archived replay exposes events, not per-frame GameState features, so no held per-frame state is used.
The mapping from a game feature to a BANC annotation pool is a labelled hypothesis or convention, not a measured sensory pathway.
No confirmatory p-value is claimed across the three non-independent streams; evidence level E4 is not claimed.
A motor spike or decoder label is not a biological motor command.
